_what: Gen 2x2 magnet-mechanic hero, no people — demonstrates the 2.0 product route at 4K. Run with --draft for the 2.0-mini tier or --fast for 2.0-fast (both rates unprobed; the engine says so instead of inventing a number).

images.describe: The device shown in reference image 1, reproduced faithfully: a small rectangular block made of TWO SEPARATE MAGNETIC HALVES. The LEFT half is matte black with a clear window of amber oil and a tropical sticker label reading 'CANARY ISLAND PUNCH'. The RIGHT half is polished gold brass with a clear window of amber oil and a red sticker label reading 'DC-10 Diesel'. The black half is ALWAYS Canary Island Punch and the gold half is ALWAYS DC-10 Diesel — never swap them. Both halves stay whole and correctly shaped in every frame.

scene.look: Studio product hero on a dark reflective surface. The assembled device stands upright, keyed by one warm low light from the left that catches the gold half and the amber oil windows. Slow, heavy, premium.
scene.camera: Locked-off camera. The two halves separate with a clean horizontal pull, hold apart for a beat so both labels read, then snap back together flush with a visible magnetic settle. No hands in frame — the halves move as if placed by magnets themselves.

beats.action: Assembled device, light raking across the gold half.
The halves pull apart horizontally and hold, both labels legible.
They snap back flush with a small settle.

proof._why: No hands manipulate props — the halves move alone, and the whole clip IS 5s, proof-length.
